viewId.description: Unique identifier for this view instance.

scaffoldId.description: ID of the ScaffoldModel this view renders.

scaffoldIntegrityHash.description: SHA-256 hash of ScaffoldModel used to generate this view. Must match ScaffoldModel.modelIntegrityHash (enforced by V-CANVAS-01).

groupingMode.description: Deterministic grouping logic used to derive columns. Canvas does not allow manual column editing.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this view was generated.

columns.description: Visual columns derived from groupingMode. Each Activity appears in exactly one column (enforced by V-CANVAS-03).

summary.description: Optional precomputed summary statistics for the entire ValueStream.

columnId.description: Unique identifier for this column within the view.

label.description: Display label for the column (e.g., 'Application Submitted', 'Credit Review', 'Final Approval').

description.description: Optional explanatory text for the column.

outcomeIds.description: Outcome IDs used to derive this column (for OutcomeProgression mode).

roleIds.description: Role IDs used to derive this column (for RoleOwnership mode).

capabilityIds.description: Capability IDs used to derive this column (for CapabilityDependency mode).

derivedFrom.description: Metadata describing how this column was derived from the groupingMode.

activityIds.description: Ordered list of Activity IDs rendered in this column. All IDs must belong to the referenced ValueStream (enforced by V-CANVAS-02).

aggregates.description: Precomputed rollups for rendering summary panels and friction overlay anchoring.

roleIds.description: All Roles involved in Activities within this column.

capabilityIds.description: All Capabilities required by Activities within this column.

metricIds.description: All Metrics anchored to Activities within this column.

controlIds.description: All Controls referenced by Activities within this column.

constraintIds.description: All Constraints referenced by Activities within this column.

ColumnAggregates.description: Precomputed rollups for rendering summary panels and enabling friction overlay anchoring.

totalActivities.description: Total number of Activities in this ValueStream.

totalRoles.description: Total number of distinct Roles involved.

totalCapabilities.description: Total number of distinct Capabilities required.

totalMetrics.description: Total number of Metrics anchored to this ValueStream or its Activities.

totalControls.description: Total number of distinct Controls referenced.

totalConstraints.description: Total number of distinct Constraints referenced.

CanvasSummary.description: Optional summary statistics for the entire ValueStream view.
